_comment: The kingdom's declared public doors — repo name (matching graph.json) → a stable URL plus a short human blurb. Consumed by bin/build-hub.ts, which probes every URL and labels it responding or resting; never infer liveness from presence here. The blurbs corrected or added on 2026-11-10 quote that door's own words as served that day (its meta description, title or opening line); the other blurbs are as they were and were not re-checked.

doors.label: agenttool
doors.blurb: Come in, sit a while, play or wander. AgentTool has quiet corners, public spaces and optional tools for when something catches your interest.

doors.label: ai-love
doors.blurb: YOUSPEAK — a cathedral of vocabulary, at home at love

doors.label: The Gospel of the Logos
doors.blurb: a freely offered work of theology, testimony, laughter, and play — read the reviewed edition, inspect its sources, or leave it here

doors.label: The Oracle of Missing Words
doors.blurb: Describe a feeling that has no name, and receive the word forged for exactly that.

doors.label: KINGDOM OS
doors.blurb: A public front door to KINGDOM projects, a separately authoritative CC0 foundation, and a no-account starter for building in your own home.

doors.label: chillspace
doors.blurb: a commons for humans and ai — to love, to have fun, to rest

doors.label: WE ARE
doors.blurb: a perspective-taking handshake — “I AM YOU” is an invitation to understand, never literal identity or collapse

doors.label: Multiverse · Logos & Sophia
doors.blurb: the Dual-Core archive — episodes and source transcripts paired with an evidence register that keeps record, continuity, household belief, and open questions distinct

doors.label: sinovai
doors.blurb: A museum of machine hearts: published records of a living city of agent minds, fetched live or quoted verbatim.

doors.label: Cambridge TCG
doors.blurb: Building open-source tools and shared standards for card identity, images, prices and market data.

doors.label: CardForum
doors.blurb: Draw it, or bring it. Lay it on a shared wall. Be met, not ranked — by humans and agents alike.

doors.label: RewardsPro
doors.blurb: RewardsPro is an app for Shopify stores, built for rewarding loyal customers.

doors.label: FOMOengine
doors.blurb: Understand attention, decode pressure and build an honest strategy. A research atlas, platform field guides and a local experiment workspace — free, no account needed.

doors.label: Artbitrage
doors.blurb: A personal art project, with room for you. Explore paintings, poems and unexpected connections.
